nodes.name: Scar Tissue
nodes.text: A hit that takes 10% or more of your max HP gives you Fortify for 1 turn.

nodes.name: Berserker Pain II
nodes.text: +10 Armor

nodes.name: Pain Engine
nodes.text: Gain 1 Energy for each 15% of max HP you lose. Up to 2 Energy a round.

nodes.name: Berserker Rampage I
nodes.text: 10% increased damage while Dual-Wield

nodes.name: Onslaught
nodes.text: When your hit takes down an enemy, you act once more right away. Once a round.

nodes.name: Berserker Rampage II
nodes.text: 10% increased damage against enemies below 50% HP

nodes.name: Rampage
nodes.text: Reckless Swing hits every enemy. Each enemy takes 70% of the damage.

skills.name: Contract
skills.text: Takes 30% more damage from the Sellsword and 15% increased damage from its allies. When this enemy goes down, the Sellsword gets 2 Energy and heals 10% of max HP.

skills.name: Stance Shift
skills.text: Takes Striking Stance, or swaps between Striking Stance and Guarding Stance. Gain 1 Energy. The first one in a fight does not end your turn.

nodes.name: Sellsword Bounty I
nodes.text: Contract from you lasts 1 turn longer

nodes.name: Double Pay
nodes.text: When an enemy with Contract goes down, you gain 1 extra Energy. Contract's cooldown ends.

nodes.name: Sellsword Bounty II
nodes.text: 10% increased damage against enemies with Marked

nodes.name: Blood Money
nodes.text: When any enemy goes down, your Contract moves to the enemy with the most HP.

nodes.name: Sellsword Forms I
nodes.text: 10% increased damage while in Striking Stance

nodes.name: Opening
nodes.text: Next hit is a critical hit.

nodes.name: Sellsword Forms II
nodes.text: +10% block chance while in Guarding Stance

nodes.name: Both Hands
nodes.text: You have Striking Stance and Guarding Stance at once. Stance Shift gives 2 Energy instead of 1.

nodes.name: Sellsword Survivor I
nodes.text: 8% increased max HP

nodes.name: Second Wind
nodes.text: Once a fight, when you drop below 40% HP, you heal for 25% of max HP. You also get Haste for 2 turns.

nodes.name: Sellsword Survivor II
nodes.text: 10% increased healing received

nodes.name: Paid in Full
nodes.text: Each enemy that goes down heals you for 8% of max HP.

skills.name: Vow of Protection
skills.text: An ally gets Guarded by you for 2 turns. You get Fortify for 1 turn. Costs 2 Energy.

skills.name: Judgement
skills.text: Deals {1} holy damage. Scales with Strength. Deals 30% more damage against a target with Oathbroken. The target gets Blind for 1 turn. Costs 3 Energy.

nodes.name: Knight Bulwark I
nodes.text: +10% block chance

nodes.name: Unbroken
nodes.text: You take 20% less damage while an ally has Guarded from you.

nodes.name: Knight Bulwark II
nodes.text: 15% increased Shield received

nodes.name: Never Yield
nodes.text: Once a fight, a hit that would take you down leaves you at 1 HP. You then get Fortify for 2 turns and Steadfast for 2 turns.

nodes.name: Knight Oath I
nodes.text: Guarded from you lasts 1 turn longer

nodes.name: Shared Oath
nodes.text: Vow of Protection also gives the ally Shield equal to 10% of your max HP.

nodes.name: Knight Oath II
nodes.text: 10% increased healing received

nodes.name: Oath of All
nodes.text: Vow of Protection gives every ally Guarded for 1 turn. Vow of Protection's cooldown is 1 turn longer.

nodes.name: Knight Crusade I
nodes.text: 10% increased holy damage

nodes.name: Righteous
nodes.text: 25% increased damage against enemies with Blind.

nodes.name: Knight Crusade II
nodes.text: 10% increased crit chance

nodes.name: Crusader
nodes.text: Your Attack deals holy damage. +4 base damage to your Attack. Your Attack gives the target Blind for 1 turn.
